behavior.html:
The 2026 Gathering will be held October 4-6 in Kathmandu, Nepal, hosted by our long-time collaborators Karkhana Samuha. Registration is now open - the deadline to apply for travel stipends is April 31; priority registration closes May 31.

  • Learn more and register
  • Register and apply for a travel stipend
  • Submit to the call for abstracts
  • NEW! Check out the Tentative program
  • Join the discussion on the GOSH Forum

The 2022 Gathering took place from October 26-29, in Panamá City! It gathered 80 participants from 20 different countries around the theme of “open hardware for open thinkers.”

- Read the community report from the Gathering
- Read the visual notes from the Gathering 
- Notas Visuales del Encuentro por el Hardware Científico Abierto (GOSH) 2022
- Watch the videos from the Gathering

GOSH 2018 took place at Open FIESTA on the Tsinghua University Graduate Campus in Shenzhen, China from 10-13 Oct 2018 with the theme 'Scaling Hardware, Building Community' .

- Read the GOSH 2018 Community Report 
- Read the GOSH 2018 Final Report

GOSH 2017 took place at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile. The theme of GOSH 2017 was building a movement and the goal was to bring the spirit of the GOSH Manifesto to life and build a Roadmap to make open science hardware ubiquitous by 2025.

- Read the GOSH 2017 Reports 
- Read the GOSH Roadmap

GOSH 2016 was the inaugral event, taking place at CERN in Geneva. Read all about it here!

Major outcomes were:
- The GOSH Manifesto
- Our GOSH Forum!
